svg.title: PB-GR-002 printed grip - paddle interface
svg.text: SCALE 2:1 · HEAD, IN THE SLIT ZONE (y = 120)
Woven carbon/epoxy plate 4 thk, cut to the profile DXF
PA-CF printed, 1 or 2 pieces – sheet 3 of PB-EL-001 / PB-HY-001
PLA printed, any rev-8 design (drawn CARBON MATRIX), 60–65 g
DIN 7984 M3 × 12 low-head cap screw, A2 stainless
M3 heat-set, brass, 5.7 long, in a Ø4 bore
Structural epoxy (rib support to face sheets)
GRIP (3): ANY OF THE TEN REV-8 PRINTED GRIPS (pickleball_grips) - SAME INTERFACE, DIFFERENT SURFACE; DRAWN: CARBON MATRIX.
PLA 60–65 g (61.2 g DRAWN). PRINT UPRIGHT, BUTT DOWN, 100 % INFILL, NO SUPPORTS.
SLOT 30.2 × 16 × 130 DEEP, 1 LEAD-IN; HANDLE 30 × 16 NOMINAL. THE BONDED 4/8/4 STACK MAY
MEASURE 16.1–16.5: MEASURE IT, PRINT THE FIT-TEST COUPON AND SET SLOT_T (pickleball_grips/scripts/grip_core.py) TO SUIT.
END WALLS SLIT OVER THE TOP 20 (y 115–135) SO THE THROAT FLARE (FROM y = 130) PASSES;
THE GRIP SEATS ON THE BODY BUTT AT y = 5 (= GRIP BASE 5).
INSERT (5): HEAT-SET M3 × 5.7 INTO THE Ø4 BORE, FLUSH WITH THE CORE BUTT, BEFORE THE FACE SHEETS ARE BONDED.
SCREW (4): DIN 7984 M3 × 12 LOW-HEAD (M3 × 16 ALSO FITS), LOW-STRENGTH THREADLOCKER, HAND-TIGHT (≈0.5 N·m)
SO THE PLA BASE DOES NOT CRACK; 2.8 OF FLOOR UNDER THE HEAD.
OVERALL LENGTH 390 INCL. THE 5 GRIP BASE; HANDLE 130 FROM THE BUTT TO THE THROAT. MASS WITH GRIP 849 / 802 g (EL / HY).
SAME GRIP ON PB-EL-001 AND PB-HY-001. ALL DIMENSIONS IN mm.
PRINTED GRIP 135 LONG, SLOT 30.2 × 16 · M3 LOW-HEAD SCREW + HEAT-SET INSERT · BOTH PADDLES
